summary: Resolve pinned reusable CI checks for native adoption; SESSION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION: continue scanner native adoption and independently publish fixes.

delivery.outcome: Resolve literal reusable CI job contexts from explicitly reviewed SHA-pinned local source contracts during native adoption and deterministic verification.
nonGoals: No network fetch during verification, mutable-ref resolution, dynamic or nested workflow inference
No product edits, foreign source cleanup or weakening independent publication

architecture.decision: Share an offline immutable source resolver between check generation and checking; verify exact caller reference, closed contract shape, contained non-symlink source and SHA256 before deriving literal leaf job names. Fail closed for unsupported workflow shapes. Bundle the resolver in the existing Wellman transitive module closure and verify byte parity. Deliver the small atomic resolver/package closure under the hub S profile; hub M is not enabled. Keep 15 exact files, two components, one new interface, and zero runtime dependencies.
interfaceChanges: Optional .github/reusable-workflows.lock.json with reviewed immutable source bindings
architecture.rollback: Publish a reviewed corrective standard; never manufacture check success or replace target-owned policy.

validation.evidence: Literal caller/leaf names, pin drift, tampered bytes, unsafe paths, unknown and unsupported contracts.
Native scope, package and adoption gates.
Merged material standard change with coherent immutable release before target adoption.
